digest.title: Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package compromised to steal credentials
digest.tldr: Hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework Python package on PyPI, publishing two malicious versions designed to steal cloud credentials and other sensitive information from developers' systems.

digest.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella remains confident in Nvidia after Huang’s exit
digest.tldr: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed confidence in Jensen Huang's successor Colette Kress, who is serving as Nvidia's interim CEO.
